king correctly:

1. **`clamp(n, min, max)`** in `src/num.js` — limits a value to the inclusive range [min, max]
2. **`formatBytes(n)`** in `src/util.js` — formats byte counts as human-readable strings (B, KB, MB, GB) with one decimal place
3. **`slugify(title)`** in `src/text.js` — converts strings to URL-safe slugs (lowercase, trim, dash-separated, alphanumeric + dashes only)

All follow the project's conventions: two-space indentation, double quotes, early returns, and no unnecessary comments.
